newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish consumer confidence stable in Sept. -survey.
newsitem.headline: Polish consumer confidence stable in Sept. -survey.

text.p: Polish consumer confidence indicators measured by the Demoskop polling institute for the Rzeczpospolita daily were stable in September, after rising for two previous months, Demoskop said on Wednesday.
Demoskop's consumer confidence index was at 100 points in September and August after rising to 97 points in July from 95 points in June.
The business climate index fell to 98 points in September from 99 in August and the index measuring propensity to spend was flat at 101 points. @
The Demoskop survey was carried out between September 6-9 among a representative random sample of 998 adult Poles.
